shortDescription: Creates a new custom asset attribute.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: attributes
options.description: An array of new custom asset attributes.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
